title: Obedience
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child lists ways of obeying teachers and the children's government and reasons to obey (Hebrews 13:17).

floor.question: Why should children obey parents?
floor.answer: God commands it (they care for us)

steps: List ways of obeying at school.

board.say: Why do we obey this rule?

board.do: Wait for the child to give a reason.

misconceptions.ask: The teacher leaves the class. Should you keep working?
misconceptions.repair: Talk about God seeing and doing right always.

listen_for: No, she is a child like me
misconceptions.ask: Should you obey the class monitor?
Why should we obey our teachers?
misconceptions.repair: List reasons: learning, safety, order, pleasing God.

misconceptions.ask: An older pupil tells you to steal a pen. Should you obey?
misconceptions.repair: Say: we obey good instructions. If anyone asks you to do wrong or unsafe things, say no and tell a trusted adult.

checks.question: Name a way to obey teachers.
Give a reason for obeying teachers.
checks.answer: They guide us (God asks us to)
